description.value: Legends Pub & Restaurant is a well-established Richmond sports bar with roots going back to 1994, now settled in a two-storey building near Vancouver International Airport. The venue boasts over 30 TVs including three large screens, making it Richmond's self-described prime sports destination. It offers a full kitchen with daily house-made soups, a wide selection of vegetarian dishes, and off-sales beer to go.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active and corroborates the OSM record on name, phone, and general address; the OSM check_date of 2026-05-20 and live website content confirm the business is currently open. Vegetarian options and free Wi-Fi are explicitly stated on the front page ('Vegetarian options galore' and 'Free WiFi is available to our patrons'). The prominent 'ORDERS NOW' button/link on the website indicates takeout/online ordering is available. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, or charging is found anywhere in the website content.
concerns: Minor address suffix discrepancy: OSM tags use 'Blundell Road' but the website contact page lists '9031 Blundell St.' — may be the same street referred to by two common names, but worth verifying.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, currently open pub and restaurant with an active website and a very recent OSM check date (2026-05-20). Useful to touring cyclists for food, vegetarian options, Wi-Fi, and off-sales beer.
